readme_summary.problem: Traditional KYC/age checks force uploading ID/DOB to every company, storing full identity, or putting PII on-chain—creating data sprawl and breach risk without cryptographic auditability (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

readme_summary.problem: During outages you rarely have perfect metrics/traces/change tickets—mostly messy logs, overlapping failures, and decoy deploys—while engineers still need a fast working theory.
readme_summary.what_it_does: TraceIQ turns outage telemetry (esp. raw logs) into ranked suspects and a postmortem-style report. Flow: ingest (BYO JSONL or demo) with redaction → deterministic briefing/analytics → read-only agent investigation (mock or live LLM) → narrative report with citations, gaps, and sharpening asks → claim verification. Web UI: steps, swimlanes/service graph, charts, exportable report. Multi-tenant safety (JWT, workspace RBAC, Postgres RLS).
